notes.title: S2ENGINE HD 2018.1 IMPORT FIX
notes.content:
Hi guys,

[h1]THE MAIN BUG[/h1]
We have fixed a bug related to the importing procedure.
The problem wasn't due to the import algorithms themselves BUT to the editor UI. 

If you don't use the Drag'n'Drop system, sometimes the order in which importer parameters dialog and report dialogs disappear was wrong causing crashes JUST after terminating the importing procedure.

Infact users that experienced crashes said that models where perfectly imported.

The bug has been FIXED, so now you can import models either via Drag'n'Drop and via classic "import" button.

[h1]ANOTHER SUBTLE BUG[/h1]
We have also discovered and FIXED another bug causing crashes.
When you delete an object from the editor and this object uses a GameMachine FSM that sends delayed events, sometime the engine could crashes.

The solution was simple BUT hard to find: simply erasing the FSM from events queue when it is destroyed together with the owner object (I know this is a bit technical but it works :)).

Hoping you appreciate,
PROFENIX STUDIO

notes.title: S2ENGINE HD 2018.1 DDS FIX
notes.content:
Hi to all,

Today we have fixed a bug related to DDS textures importing.

[h1]THE PROBLEM[/h1]
One of S2ENGINE HD users had problems importing Trees exported in OBJ formal file from a program called [b]TreeIt[/b], a free procedural trees generator (you find it here: http://www.evolved-software.com/treeit/treeit). 
S2ENGINE crashed before completing the importing procedure.

[h1]THE SOLUTION[/h1]
At first we thought it was due to bug into the OBJ file importer, BUT after a long investigation we have discovered the problem was due to DDS textures. 
Infact TreeIt uses non-compressed DDS textures that are exported together with the OBJ file.
This particular kind of format wasn't particularly appreciated by S2ENGINE new STX system.
Found the problem, found the solution: it was FIXED :)

[h1]IMPORTANT NOTE[/h1]
After fixed the problem we have made some tests for importing trees from TreeIt.
We have found that, by default, the tree OBJ file is divided into 2 prefabs when imported: trunk and foliage. This is not so good.

To solve the problem you have to check the [b]"Optimize Graph"[/b] option into the importing dialog, as showed into the following image:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/d53e3dd1fde0ae0eebeaac778dba02a8feddb1b3.jpg[/img]
Making this the tree will be imported as a single mesh with 2 materials:)

Hoping you appreciate,
PROFENIX STUDIO

notes.title: S2ENGINE HD 2018.1 PREVIEW BEFORE RELEASE
notes.content:
Hi to all,

I'm very sorry for the big big big delay.

I know, I haven't published news for months. 
I've worked night & day to the new update, adding a lot of new things and I haven't had sufficient time to stop and think to write a "progress state" announce for a lot of time.

Today I have finally kept a bit of time for talking about What you could expect from the new S2ENGINE HD update.

First
[h1]THE NAME[/h1]
For a long time I've talked about the next update as S2ENGINE HD 1.4.6 B10 version, but, while working on it I realized that the changes are so BIG that it hadn't sense to continue calling it 1.4.6 B10, so I decided to change the version naming.
Starting from the next S2ENGINE I'll call it by keeping the year of releasing and an incremental index of the version, so the name will be S2ENGINE HD 2018.1, 2018.2, 2018.3, etc.. for this year, and 2019.1, 2019.2, etc.. for next year and so on.

[h1]NEW EDITOR INTERFACE[/h1]
The big big big change from the previous versions will be the editor interface. 
I've collected all the community suggestions, giving a look to the "today standards", and took a very "HARD" decision: 

Re-thinking the editor interface!

The changes are too many for a detailed explaination, SO
Take a look to the latest preview/tutorial videoclips I've uploaded on YouTube:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1hQxBalM2s&t=1481s https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qSBPWpxnceI&t=540s
As their names suggest they are thought not only as PREVIEW of the new version BUT ALSO as FIRST TUTORIALS

[h1]NEW PBR[/h1]
Following suggestions and requests of a part of the engine community I've completely re-designed the Physically Based Rendering system:

The new PBR shaders are based on GGX equations and roughness/metal workflow, that is the "basic workflow" of the majority of industry-standard tools such as, for example, Substance products.

The following is a sequence showing a blue coloured material with metalness=0 and roughness from 0 to 1:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/504cc0481bf8c59b273351862d81853f756cf8e8.jpg[/img]
The following is a sequence showing a yellow coloured material with metalness=1 and roughness from 0 to 1:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/7dfdb8e111a5994a5e9c74d667f9249fd92dbab8.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW OUTDOOR RENDERING[/h1]
The new PBR system forced me to also re-think the whole outdoor rendering. 

[b]ATMOSPHERIC SCATTERING[/b]
I've investigated for weeks about how it was the best way to render realistic atmospheric scattering without too many parameters to change (as in previous versions). 

Finally I came across the famous "precomputed atmospheric scattering" by Eric Bruneton. 

The results were awesome: 
No more need for a lot of parameters and all colors, sun, sky, fog, from sunrise to sunset, were just like reality.

The drawback of this tech is that the precomputation of LUTs, even if it is powered by GPU, cannot be executed in realtime, so changing some parameters like Mie and Rayleigh scattering or wavelength colors (for simulating various weather conditions) is too much slow. 

So I've also implemented a "distributed interpolated over frames precomputation of LUTs". In this way changing weather conditions is possible at the cost of changing them not too much fast, just as in reality :D

[b]CLOUDS[/b]
AT THIS POINT, made a SO REALISTIC SKY forced me to also change clouds rendering.
Clouds are very very very complex matter :)

I based my work on different papers, in particular on "Horizon Zero Dawn" and  "Frostbite engine" clouds systems.
Clouds are rendered into a 3D layer raymarching the scattering from sky and sun. 

Putting it all together was an astonishing show as you can see from the following image:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/eb1955713e83bb3b18e7489f0e68389aa3714bb4.jpg[/img]

Of course clouds are computed in realtime and a lot of parameters, like density, amount of water, scattering, and so on..., can be changed during the day.

THE ONLY LIMITATION FOR NOW is that you cannot fly trough clouds, they are only rendered as background.

The transition from day to night is absolutely smooth and you can see the moon reflecting on the environment and clouds around it when the sun is still colouring the environment and the clouds by its side!!

[b]OCEAN[/b]
Finally I've also improved the ocean, either rendering (improved sss and better foam) and simulation.
In this version the ocean supports beaufort scale.
This means you can set parameters for every ocean state (amount of foam, micro and macro waves height and normals, and so on...), from calm to rough, and then, with a single slider, change the ocean state during the time of day.

The following image gives an idea of what I mean:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/742891b797bace868124a700f702c721f52d997e.jpg[/img]

[h1]OTHER IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
As announced in previous posts I have:
[list]
[*] improved and bugfixed some other subsystems like:
[list]
 [*]Model importing
 [*]Texture managing (new STX format) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E6kew06Fagk&t=18s
[/list]
[*] I've implemented a Load/Save game system https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ha5-Ne2c0fc https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TZEUeODHnhU
[*] I've introduced Layers
[*] Last But Not Least I've Added Exporting and Texture Atlas Editing into the BUILDING GENERATOR PLUGIN https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aa7xRKUH34M&t=910s
[/list]

[h1]CONCLUSION[/h1]
In conclusion this update will contain very exciting new features BUT MOST IMPORTANT It will be the FIRST STEP for a BETTER user experience!

The next step before releasing is THE SECOND TEST PHASE and the update of all DLCs and Packages. 
Due to BIG changes, it should be another "night&day" hard work...I hope not too much long in time ;)

Cross fingers :D

The release is close... 
stay tuned guys :)

notes.title: S2ENGINE HD 1.4.6 B9 released
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Before publishing the Building Generator DLC I've made an update for a double purpose:
[list]
[*] Make the editor supporting external plugin in a transparent way
[*] Improving some feature and fix some bugs of the engine
[/list]

[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
Here are the complete list of all improvements made in this version:
[list]
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b]: MinFloat action fixed
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b]: emissive materials not showed when more than 2 objects are on screen
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b]: road intersections 
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b]: some crashes due to alpha blended materials
[*] [b]BugFix[/b]: LightBeams and Clouds not showed.
[*] [b]BugFix[/b]: Custom number of MIPMAPs for compressed textures (DDS) fixed
[*] [b]BugFix SSGI[/b]: wrong fetching of source color buffer for color bleeding (FIXED)
[*] [b]BugFix[/b]: FloatLerp and Vec3Lerp GameMachine actions output fixed
[*] [b]BugFix[/b]: layer painting into material viewport doesn't work well for masks resolutions below 256x256
[*] [b]BugFix[/b]: SetOrientationFromCamera smooth value is inverted (fixed)
[*] [b]BugFix[/b]: Runtime crashes when Terrain Detail materials are used (ex. WarBattle project)
[*] [b]BugFix[/b]: AI agents rotations exploding when framerate is slow (under 15 fps). 

[*] Replaced global UVMask Index with per-Layer uvMaskIndex
[*] Now EmissionMap and ThicknessMap UV channel is the same as Layer0
[*] Changed material property: Emissive opaque surfaces now always require emissive map
[*] Added SetMaterialEmissionColor action
[*] Added SetMaterialLayerAlpha action 
[*] Now emissive materials are also rendered into screen space reflections and screenspace global illumination
[*] Added parameter MaxCubemapReflectionDinstance for setting the maximum rendering distance of the dynamic reflection cubemap
[*] fixed DOF near and far focus
[*] removed automatic computation of SUN color in FX (eliminating this helps day to night transition tuning and helps a better match between SUN color chosen by user and SUN color applied to the sky)
[*] Added timeOfDay parameter "FogNear" in FX Weather tool
[*] Added a maskDistance parameter to alphaBlended materials for attenuating analytics reflections at distance.
[*] Improved GodRays
[*] Added parameter farOutOfFocus and cocRadius for better controlling Depth Of Field 
[*] Added parameter BloomThreshold to Post-Processing panel 
[*] Now roads, rivers, tracks and fences can be of unlimited number
[*] Added second UV Channel for roads (used for different tiling when multiple road material layers are used)
[*] Added FloatAnimate and Vec3Animate actions in GameMachine
[*] Added global parameter to SetSourcePitch and SetSourceGain actions in GameMachine
[*] Added possibility to delete detail materials of the terrain
[*] Improved smooth parameter, in all GameMachine actions that require it, taking into account framerate
[*] Added parameter frametime to GetInputAxis action in GameMachine
[/list]

[h1]EASY GAME PACK UPDATE[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]BugFix[/b]: Zombie gameMachine hides player when in IDLE01 and IDLE02 states
[*] PlayerCharacter Health parameter is now a Float instead of an Integer
[/list]

[h1]SOME IMPORTANT NOTES ABOUT THIS UPDATE[/h1]
Apart from some important bugfixes, just like Road intersections, light beams and clouds no more visible, and runtime crashes when terrain detail materials are used, this version implements some interesting improvements like:
[list] 
[*] Finally a satisfacting GodRays effect :)
[*] Finally and unlimited number of roads :D
[*] [b]Most important:[/b] improved SMOOTH parameter for GameMachine actions. It now takes into account FRAMERATE, this is particularly visible when in EasyGamePack the player character JUMPS: now he jumps the same amount independently from the framerate, that is a REAL GOOD FIX :D :D
[/list]

notes.title: S2ENGINE HD 1.4.6 - B8 - Publishing FIX
notes.content:
Hi Guys,

Basing on community reporting, I've fixed a problem regarding runtime publishing.

The S2Configuration.exe application, for configuring the runtime, didn't work properly. For some unknown reason, S2Configuration.exe dialog events weren't fired so no changes to the configuration were possible.

Now, I've fixed this. You can set fullscreen with no problems, also the S2Editor configuration is copied while publishing the runtime so you will have the same settings you see inside the editor.

[h1]Easy Game Pack[/h1]
I've also added the "Exit" button functionality to the Easy Game Pack GAME MENU, so now, when you publish a game you can exit by using the Game Menu.

Also I've found an issue into the QUIT action of the game machine. It quitted all the editor if it was used during game testing inside the editor. Now this has been fixed and QUIT action works only into the runtime

notes.title: S2ENGINE HD 1.4.6 B7 to B8 NOTES
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Here are some suggestions about how to migrate from B7 to B8 version:

- If your project contains some multilayered materials you will see some "strange" differences: to adjust them play with macroDiffuse, macroBump and macroGloss sliders inside material props panel 

- if you see your scene colors too much dark or hi-contrast see "lift / gamma / gain" post processing values inside Fx "post-processing" tool

- Take in mind that now Stock list doesn't exists anymore (no more objects "activable" parameter), if your scene had some stock objects ("activable parameter to false"), now they are automatically actived unless you have set new "ActiveAtStart" parameter to false.

Hope these info could help ;)
Stay tuned

notes.title: S2ENGINE HD 1.4.6 B8 FINALLY RELEASED!
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I'm proud to announce thet B8 update has been published :)

It is, until now, the greatest update I've ever made since Steam release.
A LOT of things have been fixed and A LOT of things have been added.

Here is the summary of all B8 PREVIEWS published plus the complete RELEASE NOTES list:

[h1]ANISOTROPIC FILTERING[/h1]
I've just implemented the possibility to set [b]Anisotropic Filtering[/b] inside engine (without being forced to use Graphics card control panel), in realtime:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/c73ba2313dc5ff139767789dc0dc31bb61729405.jpg[/img]

[h1]BROWSER NAVIGATION[/h1]
I've finally improved browsers navigation by storing the latest visited folders in a stack fashion:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/01a9a480a7b87910818dd719288d03d8a0662762.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW GIZMOS[/h1]
New, more professional and comfortable, gizmo look and improved gizmo picking:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/4ebd583ad11a5ffefa700114ea3bc15e65a53eb6.jpg[/img]

[h1]ANIMATION SPLITTING[/h1]
Partly redesigned animation system:
- reducing memory consumption for every character instance
- simplifying code
- making animation system easily extensible in future
- animation splitting

The following is a video tutorial showing how to split a "more than one clip" animation in different animations:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b_K1BGIYND0&feature=youtu.be

[h1] CUBEMAP REFLECTION OPTIMIZED [/h1]
All of you know that when checking Realtime cubemap reflections the framerate misses about 10 FPS (!!!!). 
This is due to the fact that, for drawing reflections into the cubemap, the scene must be drawed 6 times (even if simplified a lot).
For improving things I've worked on to 2 sides:

[b]REFLECTION PROXY[/b]
I've added a new parameter to the meshObjects for loading a proxy mesh to be used into reflections. When drawing objects into the reflections cubemap The system works as following:
1 - Looks for impostor
2 - if impostor not found the system looks for reflection proxy 
3 - If reflections proxy not found the system uses the last available LOD

[b]FRAME RE-PROJECTION[/b]
Reflection proxies aren't sufficient for speeding-up cubemap rendering, also they need additional work (proxy must be modelled). 
How to speed-up things without forcing users to produce new models?
Well...
I've found an elegant solution to the problem: 
why don't draw only one cubenap face at frame? 
In this way cubemap rendering increases about 6 times BUT at a cost, a single cubemap face is updated every 6 frames which is not much good due to reflections frame loss when camera moving. 
So how to reduce this side-effect? JUST reprojecting the face for the remaining 5 frames basing on camera movements! :), in this way the cubemap rendering speeds-up 6 times and the frame loss effect is sufficiently reduced. :D
In addition I've added a parameter for setting how many frames cubemap faces must be updated so you can control Quality/Speed ratio.

[h1]DAY TIME TOOL[/h1]
In the B8 version the "record" button remains checked until you uncheck it. When record button is checked and you change a parameter of the weather tool a new keyframe on the timeline is created automatically, and / or if you change a parameter on an existing keyframe it is automatically updated and recorded.

For better explain how this works I've made a new tutorial:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DyQsQ9J702M&t=5s

[h1]NEW TERRAIN LOD[/h1]
The new terrain LOD system improves memory usage, LOD transition and rendering speed respect to the previous system.
In this version the terrain LOD is performed inside shaders letting to avoid cracks between different tile LODs in a very cheap and elegant way: tiles resolution is scaled by smoothly adapting vertices basing on camera distance, so there is no more need to create different combinations of tiles geometry using much less memory.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/1ba2db3382e542e9dab3072c6ca4be05897f120e.jpg[/img]

In addition tiles resolution now can be customized letting users to decide how many tiles needed for covenring the whole heightmap: bigger resolution means less tiles and so less draw calls. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/71f493f02cc96c214652b11561e08564b574caa6.jpg[/img]

[h1]IMPROVED LIGHT DECAY[/h1]
A new equation for lights decay has been implemented. It is much more physically plausible helping expecially indoor rendering.

[h1]New layer blending[/h1]
Material layer blending shaders have been re-written by taking into account layers heightmap (stored into alpha channel). This makes the transition from a layer to another more realistic, as showed into the following animated gif:
[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/B8_blending.gif[/img]

[h1]Decals painting[/h1]
Now decals can be painted in the same way you can paint on "standard" objects. Decal alpha transparency is stored into the layer mask alpha channel. Decal layers (also alpha channel) are blended in the same way as other object materials:
[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/B8_decals.gif[/img]

[h1]Up to 132 Terrain Layers[/h1]
Finally terrain layers have been increased from 4 to 132!!
This is possible because now every terrain tile can have more than one material assigned (1 base material, just as before, plus up to  32 detail materials) to it, and every material, as usual, can have up to 4 layers for a total of 132 layers. 

For every material, terrain tiles are re-drawed, unlucky this could be potentially heavy for GPU and GPU drivers (imagine to draw the terrain up to 32 times...). 
So as an optimization the system has been designed to automatically compute the materials that a tile must have by checking if the tile covers a part of the material mask that isn't empty. In this way the tiles are drawed only if it is necessary, so speeding-up the rendering.
In addition the detail materials are skipped at a certain distance.

The terrain material editing also has been simplyfied and merged with the material editor. In this way you can easily edit terrain materials as they are standard materials: creating masks, editing layers and properties. 

[h1]IMPROVED IMAGE QUALITY[/h1]
The overall rendering quality has been improved:
- Motion Blur and Depth of Field moved into HDR stage
- Improved linear to gamma transformation by fixing banding artifacts 

[h1]ALL RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
- Added new browser mode "without Folders" also in Browser Dialogs
- Sorted classnames in active/Stock/AI/Statics lists in object selection tab
- Added FileDialog storing of latest visited folders
- Added Browsers storing of latest visited folders
- Added Anisotropic Filter setting option
- Bug Fixed: Mie phase in reflection sky
- Bug Fixed: night in reflection sky 
- Added parameter "AnimSpeed" to the "Animation" track (cutscene editor)
- Added "animation splitting"
- Added new gizmos
- Added AIdevice configuration 
- Added PathResolution and AreaThreshold parameters to AIDevice
- Improved ExclusionList inside object tools
- Bug Fixed: mid and low cubemap reflection shaders don't work
- Added parameter "reflectionProxy" to MeshObject
- Added Automatic Exposure control speed parameters in FX tool
- Animation browser dialog now remembers last loaded animation folder
- Dynamic reflection cubemap rendering speed-up
- Added Dynamic cubemap reflection rate parameter
- Bug fixed: Road path sub-segments geometry generation sometime fails
- Improved Daytime editing with automatic keyframe generation
- Bug Fixed: Daytime keyframe moving/cloning doesn't work when timeline is zoomed / panned
- Added possibility to choose the object to create class when importing a model
- Bug Fixed: Using emptyPlayer and shooting some flames when you exit from game mode the engine freezes
- Bug fixed: a bug that potentially could crash engine when exiting from game mode
- Added parameter layerMaskDistance for setting the maximum distance of additional layers of a material (it works also for terrain layers)
- Issue Fixed: some omnidirectional lights shadowmap artifacts
- Bug Fixed: SetObjectLocalOrientation action doesn't work well when smooth is enabled
- Added AWAKE event that is sent to Object FSM when it is awaken.
- Added new class VisibilityCounter that sends an event when an object is viewed a given number of times
- Added FadeTime parameter toCrossFadeMusic action
- Fixed speedTime parameter of MusicTrigger and MusicSwitch
- Changed material shaders when MacroBump parameter is TRUE. In the new version glossiness of layers upon 0 aren't taken into account when computing material glossiness.  
- Added reflectionMultiplier parameter into AmbientLight 
- Added parameter "selectable" to all entity class type objects
- Added GetSelectableRootObjectName action in GameMachine
- Added GetRootObject function in S2Script
- Added GetSelectableRootObject function in S2Script
- BugFixed: asseimport configuration files inverted
- Exposed Messages of Switch class 
- Bug Fixed: when rotating, traslating, scaling an entity, sometimes their transforms aren't updated when starting the game simulation
- Bug Fixed: sometimes StartGame or StartGameFromHere commands crashes the engine
- Added "Insert Default Cube" option in the New scene Frame Dialog that places a cube object when creating a new scene
- Bug Fixed: wrong UV coords when drawing the tickness map for scattering
- Now the projective textures of the lights are blurred basing on light distance
- Added parameter SS Refl Multiplier into Post Filtering SpecialFX tool
- Improved material layers blending. Now it is based on heightmap (store into the diffuse texture alpha channel)
- Changed MacroDiffuse and MacroBump materials parameters from boolean to float (i.e. from check button to sliders)
- Added parameter MacroGloss into material properties tool
- Added support for 32bit layer masks
- Added possibility to choose the format (24 or 32 bits) and resolution of the material layer mask to create. The alpha channel of the 32bit mask is used for material transparency (decals)
- Added the painting of the alpha channel of a material layer mask (useful for painting on decals) 
- Added loading of an external input map into a project
- Added "Show in Browser" icon into inspectors
- Fixed some GodRays shader artifacts
- Added Godrays setting into FX Post-processing tool
- Replaced parameter "Object" with parameter "prefab" in Splinter class
- Crash fixed: When PrefabViewport, containing an object (es. a Splinter) that spawns and attaches another object, is closed  
- Crash Fixed: When it is selected an object that is destroyed by another object (i.e. not explicitly by user) during simulation (editing with freezeAll to off)
- Added FadeIn and FadeOut parameters to ParticleSystem class, for controlling the particles in and out transparency fading
- improved ocean reflections
- MotionBlur and Depth Of Field moved from LDR to HDR stage
- Improved linear - gamma conversion quality in the darkness (avoiding banding)
- Improved Vignette shader
- Added vignette settings
- Added Film grain effect
- Removed Stock Objects list and "activable" object parameter
- Added "ActiveAtStart" parameter to objects
- Added possibility to paint on materials directly on dynamic (active) objects
- ColorDialog now affect instantly material layer color 
- Improved Object cloning when in hierarchy
- Improved object spawning when in hierarchy
- Improved ocean foam
- customizable ocean simulation speed
- added Layer Mask UV clamp flag
- Changed ActivateObject action: pos and angles parameters disabled
- BugFixed: wrong browsers update when load a new project and "ShowFOlders" mode is false
 
[b]GENERAL IMPROVEMENT TO TERRAIN[/b]
- Added multimaterials support (up to 124 additional layers + 5 layers of the base material)
- Added slopeMin - slopeMax, heightMin - HeightMax, slopeFallof - heightFallof parameters for the layers of the terrain base Material
- Improved layer blending
- Terrain Painting GUI re-designed 

[b]GENERAL IMPROVEMENT OF HIERARCHY / ATTACHING SYSTEM[/b]
- Bug Fixed: When adding more than one prefab in which there is complex hierarchiy of entity objects, the objects creation into scene fails 
- Bug Fixed: When cloning objects in which there are complex hierarchies of other entity objects the copy fails
- Bug Fixed: When Moving an object from a node of a hierarchy to another node of the same hierarchy the system fails
- Bug Fixed: When attaching and object to a node which parent is an entity that has another parent the system fails
- Bug Fixed: when cloning an object inside a hierarchy, its clone loses world transform
- Added IN_EDITOR event in GameMachine default events list. 

[b]EASY GAME PACK[/b]
- Bug fixed: Freeze all, create a new player character, move the player and then un-freeze all, the engine crashes. 
- Improved explosions

[h1]THANKS TO ALL SUPPORTERS[/h1]
Thanks to all who believe in S2ENGINE HD project
I hope you enjoy this update :)

Stay tuned!

[h1]IMPROVED LIGHT DECAY[/h1]
A new equation for lights decay has been implemented. It is much more physically plausible helping expecially indoor rendering.

[h1]New layer blending[/h1]
Material layer blending shaders have been re-written by taking into account layers heightmap (stored into alpha channel). This makes the transition from a layer to another more realistic, as showed into the following animated gif:
[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/B8_blending.gif[/img]

[h1]Decals painting[/h1]
Now decals can be painted in the same way you can paint on "standard" objects. Decal alpha transparency is stored into the layer mask alpha channel. Decal layers (also alpha channel) are blended in the same way as other object materials:
[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/B8_decals.gif[/img]

[h1]Up to 132 Terrain Layers[/h1]
Finally terrain layers have been increased from 4 to 132!!
This is possible because now every terrain tile can have more than one material assigned (1 base material, just as before, plus up to  32 detail materials) to it, and every material, as usual, can have up to 4 layers for a total of 132 layers. 

For every material, terrain tiles are re-drawed, unlucky this could be potentially heavy for GPU and GPU drivers (imagine to draw the terrain up to 32 times...). 
So as an optimization the system has been designed to automatically compute the materials that a tile must have by checking if the tile covers a part of the material mask that isn't empty. In this way the tiles are drawed only if it is necessary, so speeding-up the rendering.
In addition the detail materials are skipped at a certain distance.

The terrain material editing also has been simplyfied and merged with the material editor. In this way you can easily edit terrain materials as they are standard materials: creating masks, editing layers and properties.

notes.title: S2ENGINE HD 1.4.6 B8 PREVIEW #3
notes.content:
Hi guys,

First I'm sorry with all of you for the delay,
I'm relocating to a new office so I haven't had so much time/possibility to be online.

In the meanwhile I've worked to the engine as much as possible, in particular I focused my attention to the dynamic cubemap reflections feature. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/3ce1d4993dc7a16a43ca9ef7c07a00f603b1edbb.jpg[/img]

[h1] CUBEMAP REFLECTION OPTIMIZED [/h1]
All of you know that when checking Realtime cubemap reflections the framerate misses about 10 FPS (!!!!). 
This is due to the fact that, for drawing reflections into the cubemap, the scene must be drawed 6 times (even if simplified a lot).
For improving things I've worked on to 2 sides:

[b]REFLECTION PROXY[/b]
I've added a new parameter to the meshObjects for loading a proxy mesh to be used into reflections. When drawing objects into the reflections cubemap The system works as following:
1 - Looks for impostor
2 - if impostor not found the system looks for reflection proxy 
3 - If reflections proxy not found the system uses the last available LOD

[b]FRAME RE-PROJECTION[/b]
Reflection proxies aren't sufficient for speeding-up cubemap rendering, also they need additional work (proxy must be modelled). 
How to speed-up things without forcing users to produce new models?
Well...
I've found an elegant solution to the problem: 
why don't draw only one cubenap face at frame? 
In this way cubemap rendering increases about 6 times BUT at a cost, a single cubemap face is updated every 6 frames which is not much good due to reflections frame loss when camera moving. 
So how to reduce this side-effect? JUST reprojecting the face for the remaining 5 frames basing on camera movements! :), in this way the cubemap rendering speeds-up 6 times and the frame loss effect is sufficiently reduced. :D
In addition I've added a parameter for setting how many frames cubemap faces must be updated so you can control Quality/Speed ratio.

For now it is all, B8 release is close...
Stay tuned

Today I show you the second demonstration video about what it can be done with the upcoming Easy Game Pack DLC for S2ENGINE HD.

notes.title: S2ENGINE HD 1.4.6 B5 FINALLY RELEASED!
notes.content:
Hi guys,
I've finally uploaded the latest version of S2ENGINE HD.

There are a lot of news regarding expecially the engine stability.

[h1]NEW MEMORY SYSTEM[/h1]
As just explained I've worked a lot on memory management in order to better bugfixing the code and testing how memory is used.
In this version you will be able to see how much memory the engine is using and how much memory is reserved to it by the operating system, 
all in realtime!
Various leaks has been discovered and many crashes has been solved thanks to the memory manager.
Also a small work has been made on improving data alignment for better memory usage and performances.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/6497d9667bd80a0877aad6fb378027e09ef864fd.jpg[/img]

[h1]FRAMERATE[/h1]
As just said in July I've worked for improving a bit engine performances. A good job as been made on GPU synchronization and now framerate is increased.
The engine rendering is about 5-6 frame per second faster.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/8476cd999dc971409a2e65d384f29027076cf694.jpg[/img]

[h1]SCREEN SCALING[/h1]
A new parameter has been added for scaling the rendering buffers and improving framerate when in fullscreen on slower cards.

[h1]STUTTERING[/h1]
Working with my Radeon I've noticed some time frame stuttering when playing without Wait retrace synchronization (can be disable/enable in the configuration) due to GPU paralellism.
For attenuating this effect a new parameter has been added for smoothing framerate, ranging from 0 (no smooth) to 0.99 (maximum smooth). Set to 0.7 It worked very well with my Radeon. 
On Geforce the stuttering is minor and smooth parameter to 0 gives best results. 

[h1]ALL IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
Following is the list of all improvements and bugfixes:

- Added SetInstancedMaterialLayerAlpha action
- Added SetInstancedMaterialEmissionColor action
- Added Frametime action
- Added parameters to GMS (can be set from object class parameter "FSMparams", similar to already existing "scriptParams")
- Added "affectedByPause" parameter to basic object class for setting if an object must be paused together with overall game
- Added "GAME_PAUSED" and "GAME_RESUMED" system events for managing game pause for every object FSMs
- Added the "CopyToClipboard" and "pasteFromClipboard" of the joints of a model for fastly duplicating joint setting from a skinned model to another.
- Added event AIMED in GameMachine
- ActionTrigger replaced with EventTrigger
- Added a CUSTOM MEMORY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
- Added combobox instead of a simple label for choosing Drive letter in publish dialog
- Increased MOVE_OBJECT_EPSILON so now object selection is more comfortable when translate tool is selected
- Improved selection of non-model objects
- Added ResolutionScale parameter
- Fixed lake decals
- Improved Autosave
- Added an error report message at the end of importing procedure
- Increased speed of fence meshes creation/editing
- Added FSM state name duplicates check when renaming
- Fixed crash: Now FileDialogs avoid System files/folders
- Bug fixed: wrong caustics shader
- Bug fixed: crash when closing scene and terrain tool is opened
- Bug Fixed: crash when a prefab asset is selected and after closed the scene the prefab viewport or prefab frame are opened
- Bug Fixed: Leak when showing actions list dialog
- Bug Fixed: Leak in the UNDO buffer when closing a scene
- Bug Fixed: Fences normals artifact
- Bug fixed: solved camera conflicts when starting game (using startCamera parameter)
- Bug fixed: wrong results when importing skin with some vertex having more than MAX_BONES influencing it
- Bug fixed: when exit from game (ESC key), if there was a selected object, selection group is lost causing crash if SelectHierachy button is pressed
- Bug fixed: if you change the name of a widget into the GUI editor, the name is not changed inside the treelist view of the GUI, causing crash if you click on treelist item of the widget
- Bug fixed: leak when creating a new prefab 
- Bug Fixed: crash when you try to attach a widget to a parent that isn't a container
- Bug Fixed: crash when trying to update a widgetObject with class param void
- Bug Fixed: various leaks when importing models
- Bug Fixed: crash when re-importing a model while it is playing an animation in model editor
- Bug Fixed: multiple insert doesn't work well with multiple objects prefabs
- Bug Fixed: refraction surfaces do not works if ocean is set to false
- Bug Fixed: reset materials do not work in object class parameters tab
- Bug Fixed: LightBeam Object-Crash Engine
- Bug Fixed: OpenScene Action Bug
- Bug Fixed: Caustics
- Bug Fixed: Spawner Object crash
- Bug Fixed: Cannot de elevate or digging in the terrain without heightmap loaded.
- Bug Fixed: User can insert multiple duplicate entries in model animation list
- Bug Fixed: 3D River Tool-Delete Button,CrashEngine
- Bug Fixed: LookAt Action-Cutscene Editor-Crash Engine
- Bug Fixed: FSM Crash,in time show FSM Panel in Run time Game
- Bug Fixed: S2Engine will crashed when the internal explorer browse to certain folder
- Bug Fixed: Model animation default speed bug
- Bug Fixed: Cant pan up or down using Q and E in BrowseModel mode
- Bug Fixed: Character Object-Crash 1.4.6 b4-S2Script Language
- Bug Fixed: Serious memory leak in opening and closing project or scene. Usually S2Engine will crashed after open and closing 2-3 times the same project and scene.

notes.title: MEMORY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/6497d9667bd80a0877aad6fb378027e09ef864fd.jpg[/img]

Hi to all,

I was a bit absent during the last 2 months, there is a reason:
I was working on a complete Memory Management System for S2Engine.
It has been a very hard work but results are very satisfying.

[h1]WHY A CUSTOM MEMORY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM?[/h1]
Generally programmers don't care about how data are allocated/deallocated in the heap memory, 'cause they can use safely new/delete (C++ language) and malloc/free (C language) standard language allocator functions.

BUT in the case of a complex program such as a game engine there are problems using standard allocators: 
- They are too much general purpouse, so poor optimized for our specific needs
- They are black box, so it is hard to trace memory for leaks or debugging (what happens? why crashes? why consumes so much memory?)
- They are not deterministic, so you don't know where data are placed in memory and how much memory is reserved/committed

Until now S2Engine used just new/delete for allocate/deallocate data, so I encountered all these problems during the development.

Unitl now.

It's clear, as said before, that to make things better it was crucial to completely override the memory allocation/deallocation functions, in order to:
- Trace memory leaks 
- Speed-up allocations
- See what happens when something goes wrong
- Choose myself where to place data and how much reserved/committed memory must grow, for reducing memory fragmentation

[h1]S2ENGINE HD CUSTOM ALLOCATORS[/h1]
The new memory management system make all this possible. 
it is based, of course, on custom allocators. Every allocator is composed by different types of suballocators, basing on the data size: small data blocks are allocated/deallocated faster, large ones are fitted better in memory.

Each allocator manages a system module: one for rendering, one for physics, one for resources, etc.. and take into account how many allocations/deallocations are made, how much memory is used, how much memory is reserved by the operating system.

Each allocator can be configured basing on the data set it must manage (how many small data blocks? medium? large?)

Also I've noticed a sppedup of allocations/deallocations after replacing new/delete with my custom allocators.

The next image shows the memory profiler implemented into the s2engine editor. It shows you the reserved/committed/used bytes for each subsystem heap and the total

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/6497d9667bd80a0877aad6fb378027e09ef864fd.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/fe569a5f6e6366594a5078b9649027580b440573.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]FUTURE[/h1]
The memory system was the basic, very very very important milestone, it is the beginning of a new S2Engine HD development era.

With this new memory system there are things that could improve a lot in the next future, such as:
- Debugging and memory leaks fighting
- Speeding-up code 

Currently I'm continuing to test the engine witjh the new system (also it has just helped me in discovering a couple of leaks) and making the latest bug-fixing submitted on TRELLO board, before the releasing of next update.

I think next release should be more stable and a bit faster, thanks to this new memory management strategy.
I think it should be ready in a couple of weeks.

STAY tuned!

notes.title: SUMMER HOLIDAYS
notes.content:
Hi to all S2Engine HD community,

I would like to announunce that I will be away for summer holidays until 20th August.

[h1]What Am I Working On[/h1]
Before leaving you for about 10 days I would like to report you my latest steps in developing next update (b5).

I've just told you that I've worked for speed-up things a bit. This is done for now.
In the last week I've started to work on [b]memory[/b].
In particular I'm implementing a [b]custom memory management system[/b].

What I want to do is deeply tracing all memory used by the engine and reporting it, in realtime with a lot of information, to the screen just as all other profilers already implemented.

A such system should help me in preventing memory leaks and in making code much more stable and crash free, and it should help you to have a more clear view about what and how much memory you are using.

[h1]Thanks[/h1]
Thanks to all for appreciating my work. 
After summer there will be a lot of exciting news :D.

S2ENGINE will improve ever and ever!

notes.title: OPTIMIZATION PREVIEW #2
notes.content:
Hi guys,
My journey into rendering optimization continues.

[h1]Resolution Scale[/h1]
In the last iteration I've added a new parameter called [b]resolution Scale[/b]

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/c833f6f85ca8bee4122f6f29395ba8d0fd822bb1.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23073876/76131cd0e54b198f45f017ed8b0d05ad4696a214.jpg[/img][/url]

Resolution scale lets you to set the screen resolution percetage in order to boost rendering speed.
Resolution scale is different from setting screen resolution for many reasons:
1 - You have almost infinite resolutions to try changing them with a slider
2 - Game gui/text keeps original resolution (i.e. they aren't affected by scaling)
3 - Better image quality (compared to the equivalent resolution) due to bilinear filtering

In the image above the system used for test is:
- CPU i7 2.8 Ghz
- Geforce GTX 650
- 4 Gb RAM

The resolution is scaled by 75% obtaining 36 FPS for completely enlarged image (no editor GUI).

This technique has been recently used into games like DOOM and BATTLEFILED, now also S2ENGINE HD :)

[b] NOTE [/b]
Resolution can be also scaled by a 2.0 factor which means having a supersampled (perfeclty antialiased) final image for all who own a powerful system and want a better image quality

notes.title: S2ENGINE HD 1.4.6 b3 Finally Released!
notes.content:
Hi to all,

I'm proud to announce that [b]S2ENGINE HD 1.4.6 b3[/b] update has been released.

There are a lot of news in this version.
The most important are:

[h1]Viewport Navigation[/h1]
New editor viewport navigation controls have been implemented in order to make faster and easier: placing objects, finding them into the scene, inspecting them, etc...

Controls are customizable from Editor preferences dialog BUT 4 presets are just ready:
[list]
[*] S2Engine default
[*] Max
[*] Maya
[*] Blender
[/list]
Here is a video that better explains what I'm talking about:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YMKKtw6vdu8

[h1]Metalness support[/h1]
One of the main news in this update is the implementation of metalness material property.
Now every layer of a material can have a metalness value that makes the material to appear less/more "metallic":

[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/metalness2.jpg[/img]

Here is an example of how a material look can vary basing on metalness parameter:
[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/metalness.jpg[/img]

[h1]Double UV mapping[/h1]
- Custom layers mask for materials. Generally it is automatically created, in this version you can replace it with one by your own
- Double UV map that let you to assign one of two different UV channel for Material masks and every layer.
- Also you can visualize every UV map channel layout into model viewer

[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/update_3b_5.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/update_3b_4.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/update_3b_3.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/update_3b_2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Up to 8 bones per vertex skinning[/h1]
Now characters support up to 8 bones per vertex which is sufficient for a wide range of situations.

The following is the elf model taken from FUSE and them from my MIXAMO account. I have rotated some of nodes to show they are correctly skinned.

[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/mixamoRig.jpg[/img]

[h1]New "Slum Town" assets pack[/h1]
About 16 different "house floor" models, many other "complementary models" such as street signals, powerlines, etc.. and a lot of new materials for adding variety letting you to combine creating your slum town environment 
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/264965411214070099/42D5521F1E409963C6E484DC57DEF582932ED8EE/[/img]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed Bug "Graphics corruption in runtime applications"
[*] Fixed Bug "Runtime archive crashes"
[*] Fixed bug: "Empty Startup scene"
[*] Fixed bug: "AIEnableSense Action"
[*] Fixed bug: "Lod Alpha Transition"
[*] Fixed bug: "Scripted action"
[*] Fixed bug: "Sometimes crashes when stop game mode"
[*] Fixed bug: "Volume objects"
[*] Fixed Light shadowmap flickering on alpha test materials
[*] Fixed Physics simulation stepping update
[*] Fixed a bug in AIDevice that make GetFurthestTacticalPoint/GetNearestTacticalPoint actions returning wrong values
[*] Fixed Crash when deleting an object when its GameMachine graph is visible during game or is simulating
[*] Fixed bug: "Model Viewer: Lighting is not neutral"
[*] Fixed bug: "PhyVEhicleControl action"
[*] Fixed bug: "Vegetation layers subfolders"
[*] Fixed bug: Lock/unlock, freeze/unfreeze buttons update
[*] Fixed Bug: "Viewport minimization and wrong layout"
[*] Fixed bug: "Projectile material physics list"
[*] Fixed bug: "Vec3ToString action"
[*] Fixed crash when creating a character without a model
[*] Fixed automatic saving of GameMachines
[*] Fixed cloning of objects having other objects linked
[*] Fixed crash when duplicating a decal with 0 sizeVariance
[*] Fixed Bug: "PhyApplyForceToObject action"
[*] Fixed crash when delete material assign dropdown menu without assigning a material
[*] Fixed Bug related to local ambient lighs: when disabling dynamiv reflection or making amibient light reflections local light contribution isn't summed to diffuse abiemt lights
[*] Fixed bug that overwrite files when duplicated
[*] Fixed crash when start game and ShowSimulation flag is true in the FSM graph viewport
[*] Fixed Bug when closing a viewport when there are two or more viewports on screen
[*] Fixed bug: Collision shapes don't update when moving a static object that contains a hierachy of static objects with collide flag on
[*] Fixed decals depth fight
[*] Fixed bug: when saving a thumbnail preview and there are 2 or more viewports active, the output saved image is corrupted
[*] Fixed bug: After deleting an object and translating/rotating/scaling objects is selected you cannot be able to select an object if you don't use select tool

[/list]

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]

[*] [b]TUTORIALS[/b] dialog at start of the editor ha been implemented

Next days the last preview before releasing.
[b]Enjoy and Stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: S2ENGINE 1.4.6 b3 UPDATE PREVIEW #1
notes.content:
Hi Guys,

I'm continuing development of next S2ENGINE HD update.

New features were added:

- Custom layers mask for materials. Generally it is automatically created, in this version you can replace it with one by your own
- Double UV map that let you to assign one of two different UV channel for Material masks and every layer.
- Also you can visualize every UV map channel layout into model viewer

[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/update_3b_5.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/update_3b_4.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/update_3b_3.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/update_3b_2.jpg[/img]

- I've also implemented the possibility to add objects to a skinned model and save them into the model file. Useful to add weapons

[img]http://www.s2powered.com/copiasito/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/update_3b.jpg[/img]

A couple of features must be still added before publishing this update.

StayTuned!

notes.title: S2ENGINE HD UPDATED (1.4.6 b2)
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I've released a new update (1.4.6 b2).

[h1]What's New[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added [b]SetObjectNodePos[/b] action
[*] [b]ActivateObject[/b] Action Updated
[*] [b]PhyObjectSetKinematic[/b] Action updated
[*]  [b]PhyObjectSetCollide[/b] Action updated
[*]  [b]PhyRagdollSetKinematic[/b] Action updated
[*]  [b]PhyRagdollSetCollide[/b] Action updated
[*]  Fixed some issue of zombie and player FPS logic
[*]  Added [b]CubeObject[/b] class in BasePack for creating procedural non-uniform cubes
[*]  Fixed [b]PlaySound[/b] Action issue
[*]  Fixed "Update empty GUI viewport" issue
[*]  Fixed crash when place a Grass object into a scene without terrain
[*]  Fixed [b]LoadAnimation[/b] action
[*]  Fixed [b]LoadFSM[/b] action
[*]  Fixed [b]LoadPrefab[/b] action
[*]  Fixed reflections issues when scaling objects
[*]  Fixed crash when deleting a static rigid body below a physics character
[*]  Fixed decal rendering issues on scaled objects
[*]  Fixed decal flickering
[*]  Fixed bug when rotating prefab shape via inputbox
[*]  Inserted Error MessageBoxes at start 
[*]  Fixed default daytime values
[*]  Fixed [b]Steam_api.dll[/b] lack when publishing runtime
[*]  [b]Motion Blur optimization[/b] (now velocity computation is performed only on dynamic objects)
[/list]

[h1]Cube Objects[/h1]
One of the new features of this version is the integration of [b]CubeObject[/b] class inside the [b]Basepack[/b].
[b]CubeObjects[/b] are boxes that can be scaled non-uniformly. UV Texture coordinates are automatically computed basing on Cube extensions, also collision shape is automatically generated.

The following is a BONUS video showing CubeObject use case:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WGun33va23A

notes.title: S2ENGINE HD UPDATED
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Today I publish the first update after official release. 
As said I would like to publish a [b]"micro"[/b] update every 2 to 7 days basing on your feedback/bug reports.

Minor updates (for example from [b]1.4.6[/b] to [b]1.4.7[/b] version) will, probably, take more time to be released (I think about [b]1-3 months[/b]), so when time comes I'll stop "micro" updates.

[h1]ABOUT THIS UPDATE[/h1]
- Solved the crash when try to test game
- Fixed some bugs related to animations when playing the test or runtime applications
- Added possibility to choose the Drive letter when creating New project
- Added prova3.tif heightmap of the Terrain Tutorial #1
- Added a new scene (named NewScene ;)), to fastly try the "Game Test" or "publish"
- A small optimization of the SampleScene, now more "light".

[h1]ABOUT S2 SPEED[/h1]
I've also done some "FPS" tests with the "re-mastered" scene by Un-Checking [b]HiresSSAO[/b] and setting [b]RLR (Relatime local reflections)[/b] to low
and [b]LEAVING[/b] all other settings to [b]HIGH[/b]

[b]SYSTEM USED FOR THE TESTS[/b]
- CPU Intel i7 860 @ 2.8 Ghz
- GPU Geforce GTX 650 1GB
- 4 GB RAM

I've reached aboud [b]30 fps[/b] which is good for a [b]GTX 650[/b] card.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=662786015
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=662782811
